about.text: A camembert-like soft cow's-milk cheese made around Orléans and ripened at Châteauneuf-sur-Loire. It is inoculated with Penicillium candidum and ripened about two weeks at about 12 °C; the ash version is kept longer, in an ash-lined box and then in a cellar.

sources.text: What it is and how it is ripened, from the article.
